_comment: STAGE-D per-batch coverage registry -- batch 'record_layout' (D16, Tier-2 frontend cluster)
(docs/SIMULATOR.md SS12.3/12.4; full-coverage program;
work-list docs/SIMULATOR.md D16).
Run via tests/harness/gate.py <this file> (L0+L1; calls tests/harness/coverage_audit.py) and
tests/harness/mutation.py <this file> (L2).
MODULE: frontend/record_layout.py -- the structured record layout the frontend compiles a
CodeSpec into BEFORE Stim conversion: four frozen record-schema dataclasses
(RoundMeasurementRecord / DetectorLayoutRecord / FinalDataRecord / ObservableLayoutRecord),
each carrying a to_manifest(); the RecordLayout container (three record-schema properties
detector_names / measurement_keys / observable_names + to_manifest); the assembler
build_repeated_memory_record_layout(spec, *, schedule_name); final_measurements(spec) (the
qubit->final-readout-basis map); and FIVE record-KEY/NAME formatting functions check_key /
delta_detector_name / final_detector_name / final_key. The module imports NEITHER torch NOR
quimb (dataclasses + plain f-strings only), so EVERY public unit is CPU-PURE and IN-SCOPE for
full L0+L1+L2 -- out_of_scope is therefore {} (the AST reconcile refuses any gpu_bound claim on
a torch-less module).
FOURTEEN public units (AST reconcile _public_units_in_module: top-level public defs + every
public method of a top-level class). The four record dataclasses define NO __post_init__ (they
are plain frozen carriers), so each contributes only its to_manifest; RecordLayout contributes
its three properties + to_manifest. The module-level _add_final_measurement helper is PRIVATE
-> not reconciled/scored, but its incompatible-final-basis raise IS exercised + mutation-covered
through BOTH routes of final_measurements (the check-terms loop AND the logical-terms loop --
each carries a distinct context f-string). The unit set:
* 4 dataclass to_manifest: RoundMeasurementRecord / DetectorLayoutRecord / FinalDataRecord /
ObservableLayoutRecord.
* 4 RecordLayout: detector_names / measurement_keys / observable_names / to_manifest.
* 6 functions: build_repeated_memory_record_layout / final_measurements / check_key /
delta_detector_name / final_detector_name / final_key.
CPU discipline. Every unit runs on plain-Python dataclass construction (no Stim, no simulator
run), so the tests are fast + deterministic. THE LOAD-BEARING PART is EXACT-STRING pinning of the
record KEYS/NAMES: the four formatting functions produce the record-schema keys, so each is
pinned against an INDEPENDENT f-string recompute (reconstructed from the source format, NOT the
module's own expression) with an assert_discriminates wrong-format variant (swapped fields /
missing separator / wrong prefix) -- a mutant that changes the separator, field order, or prefix
fails the pin. build_repeated_memory_record_layout is pinned by a from-scratch _view()
reconstruction of every RoundMeasurement/Detector/FinalData/Observable record (key, index, kind,
keys, coords) on a rich d=3 rounds=3 rep-code fixture -- the round-count, per-round delta naming,
round-1 delta key wiring (round_index-1), final-closure key/coords (rounds-1, float(rounds)), and
the sorted final-readout map are all pinned. final_measurements is pinned on the same fixture
(qubit->basis map, incl. the same-basis merge branch) plus its incompatible-basis raise is
tripped through BOTH final-check-closure and final-logical-observable routes with the EXACT
message via str(excinfo.value)==... The record properties (detector_names / measurement_keys /
observable_names) are pinned vs an INDEPENDENT extraction from the constructed records (a
comprehension over the record objects the test built, NOT the module's property), with an
assert_discriminates dropped/wrong-name variant; measurement_keys carries BOTH round_measurement
keys AND final_data keys so the concatenation is load-bearing. Every to_manifest is pinned to its
EXACT dict (keys/coords coerced to lists; default coords=() -> []).
NO exemptions + NO out_of_scope: every unit is CPU-pure and every branch is REACHABLE through a
constructor/assembler route (checked, not assumed -- the D13 default-arg/guard-route lesson): the
delta-round loop range(1, rounds) is entered AND exited (rounds=3), the final-closure loop runs,
final_measurements' first-insert (existing is None) / same-basis-merge (existing == basis) /
conflict (existing != basis) arcs are all tripped, and the private _add_final_measurement raise is
reached through EVERY input route reaching it (check route + logical route).
